item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Muse 1.0.53
item.description:
macOS Visual AI Asset Management Software

Muse is a native macOS AI visual bookmarking and asset management software that consolidates web links, images, screenshots, GIFs, videos, and text notes into a searchable local library. It is ideal for collecting design inspiration, organizing research materials, and saving web content. Quickly add items by dragging and dropping, pasting, web clipping, or taking screenshots. The collection wheel around the cursor, the global search launcher, and the sidebar at the edge of the screen make saving, archiving, and retrieving materials part of your daily routine. The software supports nested collections, multiple categorizations, manual tags, independent notes, and batch operations, and provides mood boards, cards, lists, and a free canvas that can be exported as a PDF. The built-in AI can automatically add tags and recognize text and colors in images. Combined with the optional visual search component, it can find content based on meaning. Data is stored as actual files in Finder-visible folders, supporting scheduled backups, imports from multiple sources, and syncing to iPhones and iPads via personal iCloud. With a built-in MCP server and local API, it can connect to AI applications like Claude and Codex, or to your own scripts, to help you find, save, and organize your library.

item.title: Nameshot 1.0
item.description:
Automatically rename Mac screenshots

Nameshot is an intelligent screenshot and image renaming tool for Mac that generates easily recognizable file names based on image content, helping users organize screenshots on their desktop that are named by date and time. The software resides in the menu bar and supports automatic naming after taking a screenshot. You can also drag and drop images or folders onto the menu bar icon for processing, reducing the need to view and modify file names one by one. For existing files, Nameshot offers desktop-based centralized organization and batch renaming of entire folders. If a name is unsuitable, you can undo it with one click or enter a name manually. The software learns from the changes and improves subsequent results. Content reading is performed locally with the help of Apple Intelligence, without the need for an internet connection, API keys, or model downloads. No account registration is required, and no analytical tracking is performed. The developer declares that no data is collected. Automatic naming, desktop organization, batch renaming of folders, naming preferences, and learning features are part of Nameshot Pro.

item.title: Folders Mini 1.0.1
item.description:
macOS File Dialog Enhancements

Folders Mini is a file dialog enhancement tool for macOS 13 and later. It displays a complete folder tree alongside the system's standard Open and Save dialogs, allowing users to directly click on the target folder to navigate to it, reducing the need to search through each level of the path. The folder tree covers Favorites, Personal Home Folders, Internal and External Disks, Network Shares, and WebDAV, and also supports cloud storage locations such as iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, and Google Drive. When users switch directories within the dialog box, the selected state in the tree view will update accordingly, and changes to the folder structure will also be reflected in real time. The software supports adjusting themes, accent colors, font sizes, line spacing, sorting, and visibility, and provides indentation guides, tag colors, and custom folder icons. Settings can be synced across multiple Macs via iCloud. Using the folder context menu, you can also open directories in Finder or your preferred terminal, manage favorites, copy folders or paths, and set color and text labels. The buttons at the bottom control the display of hidden folders, software packages, and apps, and support both Simplified and Traditional Chinese;

item.title: PathBridge 1.0.2
item.description:
macOS Network Path Conversion Tool

PathBridge is a path conversion tool for hybrid Mac and Windows work environments. It maps Windows file paths in emails, Teams messages, Word documents, and PDFs to their corresponding locations on Mac, and can also convert Mac file paths to Windows format for easy sharing with colleagues. After setting the correspondence rules between drive letters and locally mounted directories, you can open the path through the System Services menu or copy the Windows-formatted path in Finder. You can also enable clipboard recognition as needed. The software can handle line breaks, space encoding, quotation marks, parentheses, and text with notes following the path. The Pro version further offers keyboard shortcuts, support for UNC paths and dedicated links, multi-path selection, file system matching and error correction, history, and quick previews. It can also initiate a connection when a network drive is not connected and prompt for reconnection when the connection is interrupted. Up to ten sets of environment rules can be used for office, home, and VPN scenarios. The software uses Apple's App Sandbox, and the scope of access is authorized by the user. Confirmation will be requested before opening an app, installer, or script;

item.title: SelfPub Cover Designer 1.0.2
item.description:
Book Cover Design Software for Mac

SelfPub Cover Designer is a Mac book cover design software for self-publishing authors. It can create covers for paperback books, hardcover books, e-books, and audiobooks within the same project, and is compatible with print-on-demand services such as Amazon KDP and IngramSpark. After entering the finished size, number of pages, and paper type, the software automatically calculates the spine width, bleed, and safe area. You can also import official templates from printing platforms. Different versions share the same front cover design, and the back cover, spine, and flaps are retained separately to facilitate a uniform visual style. The editing tools include font effects, graphic drawing, image cropping and masking, layer grouping, guides and snapping, and support for ISBN barcodes, QR codes, and up to 300 undo steps. Built-in wizards and cover styles help you get started quickly, while pre-press checks and CMYK previews help you identify issues such as text overrun, blurry images, and excessive ink usage. E-book covers support JPEG, PNG, and TIFF export. Pro offers features such as PDF/X-1a for printing, audiobook cover export, background removal, and 3D mockups without watermarks.

item.title: Burrow 0.4.4
item.description:
Graphical Interface of Mole Cleaner

Burrow is an open-source macOS cleanup and system maintenance tool based on the Mole cleanup engine and featuring a native SwiftUI interface. The project repository is called Mole-GUI. It integrates cache cleanup, app uninstallation, disk analysis, and system monitoring into a graphical interface, allowing users to view scan results and perform maintenance operations without needing to enter commands in the terminal. Before cleaning, you can preview the items to be processed by category. When uninstalling an app, you can check for associated remnants, and you can also find caches, logs, and settings files left behind by deleted apps. The disk tree map allows you to view space usage layer by layer and move selected items to the Trash. Cleaning up project build directories, organizing old installation packages, and streamlining Intel code in common applications help further free up storage space. The overview page displays available space, health score, processor, memory, battery, and network status in real time, and shows the current step and the space freed up when performing tasks. The software retains Mole's security checks and protection rules, and supports scan result caching, operation history, protected path settings, and Touch ID authorization.

item.title: Saundo 0.6.2
item.description:
Mac System Audio to HomePod

saundo is an open-source AirPlay 2 audio streaming tool that supports macOS and Windows. It can stream system audio from browsers, games, media players, and other sources to HomePod, HomePod mini, or Mac receivers on the same network, and it supports HomePod stereo pairing. The software uses a native tray interface and captures system audio on Mac via Core Audio at 44. The 1 kHz ALAC audio stream is transmitted in synchronization with the PTP clock, offering low-latency, standard, stable, and custom latency modes. Users can automatically discover receiving devices or manually add them by IP or hostname, configure automatic connection on startup, set device-specific latency compensation, and protect pairing credentials with macOS Keychain. The menu bar panel integrates media covers, track information, playback controls, and five-band dynamic levels. It also allows you to adjust the HomePod's top light and the time after which the light turns off when idle. During connection, the device supports automatic muting of its own output, which is restored after disconnection. It also features reconnection after disconnection and a connection stability indicator.

item.title: MaCursor 2.8.2
item.description:
System Cursor Theme Replacement

MaCursor is a custom cursor theme tool for macOS that can replace common pointer styles in the system, such as arrows, text cursors, crosshairs, and wait pointers, with your favorite original designs. It supports one-click application and quick switching. It comes with over 34 built-in themes, allowing you to either directly select ready-made options or import Windows .cur and .ani cursor files, preserving animations and image details. The software provides a complete visual theme editor that allows you to set metadata, cursor lists, hotspot coordinates, number of frames, and animation duration separately. It also supports 1× and 2× image resources for Retina displays. With global hotkeys and background assistive tools, users can instantly switch themes in any application and automatically restore the current style after re-logging in or switching users. MaCursor is a custom cursor theme tool designed for macOS. It supports replacing system-level pointer styles, importing external cursor files, editing complete themes, and quickly switching between them with keyboard shortcuts. It is suitable for users who want to personalize the appearance of their desktop or create a unified visual style.

item.title: Adrafinil 1.14.2
item.description:
Wake On Mac Tool for AI Agents

Adrafinil is a menu bar resident tool for macOS. It is designed for users who need to run AI programming agents for a long time. It can keep the Mac awake during the task execution of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Devin, Aider, Hermes, OpenCode, Cline, Pi and other agents. Even if the display is closed, it can continue to work and automatically release and keep awake after the task is over. The software keeps track of different agents and sessions through the hook mechanism, supports multiple agents to run at the same time, get and release by session, keep awake at regular intervals, and manually put the system to sleep. It also provides command-line and MCP access, facilitates access to custom workflows, and implements lid-closing operation control through a privileged auxiliary program. For unattended scenarios, Adrafinil has built-in temperature protection, automatic cleaning of abandoned sessions, and a wake-up timeout mechanism to reduce the risk of equipment running for a long time. At the same time, Adrafinil supports proxy process detection, lid closure audio confirmation, activity and temperature summary after lid opening, and removal of relevant hooks during uninstallation.

item.title: Mac Sai 1.32.0
item.description:
Open-source Mac cleanup and optimization tool

Mac Sai is an open-source cleanup, optimization, and security scanning tool for macOS, built with Swift 6 and SwiftUI and notarized by Apple. It is ideal for users who want to manage their system status with transparent code and a native interface. It integrates smart scanning, system junk cleanup, malware detection, browser privacy cleanup, startup item management, maintenance tasks, app uninstallation, update checks, disk space visualization, large file search, duplicate file detection, and secure file shredding into a single application. The software emphasizes no telemetry, no ads, and no subscription interruptions. By default, it adopts security policies such as moving files to the Trash first, blocking protected paths, reviewing symbolic links before deletion, providing dry run previews, and maintaining operation logs to reduce the risk of accidental deletion. The menu bar monitoring component displays the CPU, memory, disk, battery, network, swap space, and protection status in real time, allowing users to quickly check the health of their Mac without opening the main window.

item.title: Free Download Manager 6.36.0
item.description:
BT and Magnet Link Downloads

Free Download Manager (FDM) is a powerful, modern download accelerator and management tool for Windows, macOS, Android, and Linux. It provides a fast, secure, and efficient download experience, supports downloading videos from popular websites, handling torrent and magnet links, and features proxy support as well as HTTP/HTTPS/FTP/BitTorrent support. FDM features a user-friendly interface with a modern design, allowing for flexible adjustment of bandwidth usage, organization of downloads, and control over file priorities across different platforms. It efficiently handles large file downloads and can resume interrupted downloads. It can also increase download speeds by up to 10 times, supports completely free use without ads or malware, and is compatible with mainstream browsers. Free Download Manager is a powerful, modern download accelerator and management tool for Windows, macOS, Android, and Linux. It can effectively increase download speeds and organize and manage various download tasks.

item.title: Look Launcher 0.7.5
item.description:
Lightweight launcher with keyboard priority

look is an open-source, lightweight launcher for macOS, Windows, and Linux. It focuses on keyboard operation and local data processing and can serve as an alternative to Spotlight and Raycast. Use a keyboard shortcut to open the search window, where you can find and open applications, files, and folders, access the text and image clipboard history, and execute quick commands, reducing the need for mouse operations and window switching. The software is built on a Rust core. The macOS version uses a native SwiftUI interface and supports both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. The Windows and Linux versions are based on Tauri and the system WebView, eliminating the need to bundle a full browser. The index, clipboard, and usage history are stored locally. No telemetry data is collected, and no account registration is required. Provides keyboard operations for files and applications, such as Finder navigation, opening in an editor, launching a terminal from the current location, and switching between running applications. Also offers access to calculation tools, Pomodoro timers, to-do lists, and system-related commands.

item.title: Bounce 41.0
item.description:
Wireless Connection Between Mac and Android

Bounce Connect is a local wireless collaboration tool designed specifically for Mac and Android connectivity. It enables features such as sending and receiving text messages, syncing notifications, managing calls, clipboard sharing, and file transfers within the same local area network, allowing mobile content to appear on macOS as if it were a native feature. It supports two-way connections and does not rely on cloud servers. All messages, notifications, contacts, and files are transmitted within the local network and protected by AES-256-GCM encryption to ensure data security. The software also offers practical features such as an iMessage-like messaging interface, dual SIM dialing and messaging, WhatsApp call handling, replyable desktop notifications, remote file browsing, Safari and Chrome link continuity, and image and text clipboard synchronization, making it suitable for users who frequently switch between their computers and Android phones. Bounce Connect is a local wireless connection tool for Mac and Android that integrates text messages, notifications, calls, files, contacts, and clipboards into a single cross-device workflow, allowing you to handle mobile content directly on your Mac and experience near-native system integration.

item.title: Shadowrocket 2.2.93
item.description:
Powerful Rule-Based Proxy Client for Mac

Shadowrocket is a rule-based proxy and network debugging tool for the Apple ecosystem. It can be used on iPhones, iPads, Macs, and Apple TVs, and is suitable for users who need to manage network connections, analyze requests, and maintain proxy configurations in a refined manner. It can capture HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, and DNS requests generated by applications on the device and distribute them based on criteria such as domain names, suffixes, keywords, IP CIDR, and GeoIP, making direct connection, proxy, blocking, and rewriting policies more controllable. The software supports importing rule files from URLs or iCloud Drive, and provides traffic statistics, network speed measurement, local DNS mapping, ad blocking, HTTPS decryption, URL rewriting, IPv6, proxy chain forwarding, and various encrypted DNS solutions.

item.title: AnySearch Pro 3.6.1
item.description:
File search tool for macOS

AnySearch Pro is a fast file search and disk content analysis tool for macOS that uses smart indexing and full-text search to find files among hundreds of thousands. A global hotkey opens a floating search panel from any app, and you can search by contains, prefix, suffix, exact match or wildcard. It supports combined filters (extension, type, size, modified date, folder scope, disk source) and searches the text of PDF, Markdown, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, highlighting matches in snippets. Results support quick preview, opening, revealing in Finder, and copying names or paths. Real-time file system monitoring keeps the index current, including iCloud Drive and external USB and Thunderbolt disks.

item.title: Screens 5 5.10.3
item.description:
Cross-platform remote desktop control

Screens makes it easy to remotely control your Mac, Windows computer, Linux computer, or Raspberry Pi, whether you're at home, in a coffee shop, or anywhere else in the world. It's a versatile remote desktop solution known for being fast, secure, and reliable, giving you a seamless device control experience. By installing Screens Connect, you can access your computer from anywhere in the world, and Screens also fully integrates with Tailscale, making it easy to connect to a Linux computer or Raspberry Pi remotely. The curtain mode of Screens protects your privacy, the secure connection function ensures a secure connection to the computer, and supports SSH keys to increase security. It also offers features such as accessible Mac login, display selection, clipboard sharing, session selection, and is compatible with the Raspberry Pi 5, supporting file transfers and an easy-to-use interface, while also helping friends and family through the free Screens Assist tool.

item.title: PeakHour 6.2.5
item.description:
macOS Menu Bar Network Traffic Monitor

PeakHour: Internet Monitor is a real-time network monitoring tool for macOS that centralizes bandwidth, latency, wireless signals, and connection health to troubleshoot video conferencing issues, slow downloads, network outages, and poor broadband performance. The software displays Mac, router, and carrier-to-Internet connectivity paths through menu bars and visual dashboards, helps determine where performance bottlenecks lie, and enables monitoring of UPnP or SNMP-capable routers, switches, and NAS. Built-in speed measurement combines download speed, upload speed, and rpm responsiveness ratings, and you can also see actual performance against your broadband plan. Wi-Fi analytics identifies weak signals and distractions, while historical charts make it easy to look back at traffic, delays, congestion, and disconnections. Apple Intelligence-based network consultants can rate connections, explain questions and advise in plain English, and require a Mac that supports that capability.

item.title: Ember 1.6.10
item.description:
Private life diary software

Ember: Journal & Life Archive is a private logging tool that combines diary and interpersonal memory archives for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. When writing down daily, just mention a person in the text, and the relevant content will be gathered on the other person's personal page, gradually presenting the common experience, the time of acquaintance and the context of contact; You can also organize people by circles, such as home, work or campus, and use stories to record chapters of life that span many years. Dynamic retrospectives reimagine old memories on the right dates and gently remind you to keep an eye out for people you haven't been in touch with for a long time. The software provides calendars, maps, and people maps to help you navigate through life's snippets from dates, places, and networks, as well as support for searching text throughout your archives and photos. You can add photos, videos, voice memos, Apple Music songs, and weather, and import Day One, Apple Journal, and contacts. The diary is saved on the device and can be locked with Face ID, Touch ID or password and synced privately via personal iCloud;

item.title: Trellis File Manager 2.5.1
item.description:
powerful file manager for macOS

Trellis File Manager is a visual file management tool designed for Mac that places each open folder in a separate panel on the canvas and displays the folder hierarchy via a path connection for easy side-by-side viewing, drag-and-drop movement, and comparison of content. The software supports tree alignment to the right or down, manual positioning, smooth zooming, trackpad zooming, and canvas dragging, and can manage different tasks using workspaces, favorites, Finder labels, and color branches. Built-in indexes quickly display folder sizes, search for files, locate results, and view disk usage through a space view. It supports local disks, removable hard disks, SD cards, network sharing, and a variety of cloud disk locations, and can record the directory and preview information of disconnected drives. File operations include breakpoint resurfacing, folder merging with the same name, batch renaming, undo recovery, folder comparison, and duplicate file lookup, while galleries support photo, video, PDF, Office document, font, and 3D model previews, as well as image conversion and compression. The software does not require an account, the index remains native, is compatible with Apple chips and Intel Macs, and provides a multilingual interface.

item.title: Agenda 23.4.5
item.description:
macOS all-around note-taking tool

Agenda is a cross-platform note-taking application that wins the Apple Design Award. It seamlessly integrates calendar events into the note-taking system through a unique timeline to help users manage past records, current tasks and future plans at the same time. It supports adding dates to notes or directly related calendar events, marking "On the Agenda" to quickly view key items, rich text editing functions (titles, lists, tables, etc.), file attachment previews, Project sorting, multi-device iCloud or Dropbox synchronization, and multi-person collaborative sharing of notes. The free version is complete with no time limit. The Pro version can unlock all advanced features through annual subscriptions or one-time lifetime purchases, allowing individuals and teams to promote projects and plan their lives more efficiently in the fields of business, engineering, scientific research, education, and creativity. Agenda is an Apple Design Award-winning macOS (and iOS) note-taking app that uniquely blends calendar events with notes to help users manage past, present, and future tasks and projects through timeline organization, making daily planning, meeting preparation, and project advancement more efficient and orderly, especially for business people, engineers, teachers, students, and creative workers.

item.title: ReadKit 4.1.0
item.description:
Powerful RSS Reading App for Mac

ReadKit is a powerful cross-platform reading center application for macOS and iOS. It integrates post-reading, RSS feeds and news aggregation. It supports mainstream RSS services such as Feedly, Inoreader, Feedbin, and post-reading services such as Instapaper and Wallabag. It also has a built-in RSS engine, allowing users to directly subscribe to and manage massive news feeds without additional subscriptions. ReadKit provides multi-account unified management, intelligent folder automatic classification, full-text extraction reading mode, offline cache reading, gesture shortcuts, built-in browser browsing links, automatic background synchronization, sharing extensions to quickly save Safari articles, etc. The interface supports custom themes, light dark mode and application icon switching. Keyboard operation optimization is perfect for Mac hardware keyboard. Users can achieve advanced content filtering through smart folder rules, automatically mark read or starred, easily manage mass articles in combination with powerful search and filtering systems, YouTube channels and playlists can also be subscribed through RSS, and OPML file import and export makes migrating subscriptions easy.

item.title: ServerCat 26.11.2
item.description:
Server Docker Container Management Tool

ServerCat – SSH Terminal & Linux Monitoring is a macOS tool designed for server operations and development environments, offering integrated management capabilities centered around SSH connections, status monitoring, and automated operations. Without installing additional third-party programs, it allows users to view the operating status of cloud servers, hosts, and Docker containers through a single SSH account. It supports real-time monitoring of key metrics such as CPU core usage, GPU utilization, memory, network traffic, and disk read/write operations. It also helps users stay informed about the status of machine learning-related devices at all times. The app provides features such as SSH key management, command snippets and instant batch execution of commands, container management, and terminal color scheme switching. It also supports secure data synchronization across multiple devices via private iCloud. Combined with Touch ID or Face ID, it further protects the security of operations and maintenance content, making it suitable for users who frequently need to remotely manage servers.

item.title: Capture 3.5
item.description:
Note-taking and idea-gathering tool for macOS

Quick Notes – Capture is a quick note-taking and idea-gathering tool for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision, and Apple Watch, with a core experience centered around low-friction input, instant organization, and cross-app flow. It is suitable for first capturing spontaneous ideas, to-do lists, web links, image attachments, voice content, and reminders, and then exporting them as needed to commonly used tools such as Obsidian, Things, Todoist, iA Writer, Craft, OmniFocus, Fantastical, Apple Calendar, Reminders, etc. The software supports iCloud syncing, desktop and lock screen widgets, share extensions, Siri and Shortcuts, automatic recognition of dates and URLs, document scanning, list sorting, merging and splitting of records, and other features. It can serve both as a daily outlet for clearing your mind and as a hub between different productivity systems. Its interface emphasizes simplicity and stability, avoiding distractions caused by complex workflows, allowing users to quickly save ideas when inspiration strikes and then process, archive, or execute them at the appropriate time.

item.title: Archimedes 1.9.6
item.description:
Markdown and LaTeX Editors

Archimedes is a Markdown editor designed for Mac, aimed at simplifying mathematical writing and supporting inline LaTeX. As a full-featured plain text and Markdown editor, Archimedes features fast syntax highlighting and convenient keyboard shortcuts, allowing users to easily insert images and links, making document formatting and structuring elegant and simple. In math mode, users can quickly start using a subset of LaTeX by typing $$. They can enjoy support for over 700 intuitive commands, and Archimedes can automatically complete commands and intelligently match parentheses. Users can leverage the Magic Type feature to draw symbols with gestures, and Archimedes will automatically recognize and insert the corresponding code. The real-time preview feature allows users to see the typesetting effect at any time while writing, and supports custom themes and dark mode. Similarly, Archimedes offers a range of practical features, including macros, a navigator, error checking, sharing capabilities, and document statistics. Users can also quickly format mathematical expressions using the Snippet Editor, and the app supports iCloud document synchronization, making it easy to resume work at any time.

item.title: Stash 5.1.0
item.description:
Clash Rule Agent Wall Climbing Tool/Surge Same Type

Stash is a simple and powerful networking tool for macOS and iOS that supports Apple Silicon and Intel devices, taking over and processing system network traffic based on the Apple Network Extension Framework. It can redirect, block or triage connections according to rules, with YAML unified configuration management agent group, routing logic and reusable rules, suitable for advanced users who need fine-grained control over network behavior. The built-in HTTP Engine can crawl, view, and debug HTTP and HTTPS requests, show details such as protocol type, handshake time, connection time, and modify requests and responses through decryption, rewriting, and JavaScript scripting. Stash also offers web tools like SpeedTest, Route Table, iPerf, and Diagnosis to help developers, testers, and privacy-conscious users analyze app networking behavior, troubleshoot interface issues, and reduce tracking and ad traffic.

item.title: Keylume 2.4.1
item.description:
macOS Demo Keyboard Tool

Keylume is a stylish on-screen keyboard tool designed for macOS for screen recording and live demo scenes. Keylume provides a complete view of the Apple keyboard, including media keys, arrow keys, and all modifier keys, perfectly matching the look and layout of a real Apple keyboard, many other key visualization tools only show modifier key combinations or omit function keys, while Keylume shows the entire keyboard. Keylume has a variety of beautiful themes built in and an intuitive theme editor that makes it easy for users to create personalized styles, save themes, share them with others, or import themes made by others. Keylume automatically pops up at the start of screen recording and automatically hides after the recording stops, detecting the response in just one second, and also supports manually switching the display by tapping the fn key three times. Keylume supports hovering and tapping fn to enable auto-hiding mode, let the keyboard fade out and allow click penetration, and can freely drag and drag reposition and resize, position information will be automatically remembered. Users can set up app ignore lists to avoid repeated triggering of keyboard displays by background silent recording apps such as backup tools or picture-in-picture utilities.

item.title: LaunchMe 3.01.0
item.description:
Launchpad replacement for macOS

LaunchMe is a full-screen workspace launcher for macOS 26 Tahoe and macOS 27 that replaces the removed Launchpad and adds file search, clipboard history, a calculator, music and weather widgets, live wallpapers and automation workflows. It organizes apps, folders, project files and widgets in one immersive interface, and you can save Spaces presets to launch all the apps and files for a task in one click. You can customize folder colors, emoji, covers, app icons, icon size and system icon appearance, hide titles or apps, and summon it with trackpad gestures, hot corners, multi-display support and custom shortcuts. Settings and paths are managed locally, and it pauses its process when hidden to save resources.

item.title: Vitals 1.11.2
item.description:
macOS Activity Monitor Alternative

Vitals is a system resource monitoring tool for macOS that can be used as an alternative to activity monitors in daily use, combining the statistics of applications and their auxiliary processes to visually present the CPU, memory, energy consumption, disk, and network occupancy of each application, helping to locate sources of stuttering, heating, and power consumption. The software supports custom menu bar readings and charts, saves local history for up to a year, and sends notifications when applications continue to experience high loads, memory growth, or disk and network activity anomalies. For development scenarios, Vitals organizes development servers and ports by project, marks idle services, displays Docker container resource usage, tracks programming agent sessions and their launched subprocesses, and provides information on AI program balance, reset time, and token usage. Built-in MCP services and command-line tools for Claude, Codex, Cursor, or script queries for system status. It also integrates independent application volume, temperature and fan, battery health, Bluetooth device power, GPU and neural network engine monitoring.

item.title: NotchPad 2.0.2
item.description:
Liuhai Area Quick Note Tool

NotchPad is a Mac Security Notepad app designed for MacBook Liu Haiping that cleverly integrates notepads, clipboard history, and reusable snippets into the MacBook's Liuhai area, providing quick access with just a mouse hover without switching windows or interrupting current workflows. NotchPad supports rich text editing features, including bold, italics, lists, and other formats, so users can easily pin important notes to the top and quickly find what they need with an instant search. The app enables encryption protection by default, and all data is stored locally on your Mac and never sent to any server for privacy. NotchPad syncs with Apple Notes in both directions. Users can browse and edit Apple Notes in-app, and the changes are instantly returned to the native Notes app. It also supports more than 50 file types, including txt, Markdown, RTF, Word, PDF, and various code files such as Swift, Python, JavaScript, etc. After importing, it will retain a rich text format.

item.title: NotchNook 1.6.20
item.description:
Mac Dynamic Island Notch Enhancer

NotchNook is an app designed for macOS users that offers a whole new functional experience by utilizing the notch area at the top of the MacBook. The app provides easy access to media controls, calendar events, phrases, and other useful features, significantly enhancing efficiency for daily tasks. Users can quickly control music playback and view calendar events through the notch without opening a full-screen app. It also supports real-time event display, allowing users to stay on top of their schedules at all times. NotchNook also allows users to temporarily store and transfer files by dragging and dropping them into the tray or quickly sending them to other devices via AirDrop. Users can also quickly preview the camera through the Reflection widget to prepare for video calls. Even on screens without notches, NotchNook retains its elegant functionality, supports multi-monitor setups, adapts to various workstation layouts, and serves as a practical hub for productivity-enhancing tools. With its smooth scrolling and swiping functionality, NotchNook ensures a positive user experience, truly enhancing the convenience of daily tasks.

SupaSidebar is a menu bar app designed for Mac that provides an Arc-like sidebar experience that makes it easy to save links, files, and folders so users can access them with just a tap. This app supports global keyboard shortcuts to help users efficiently use different browsers, automatically track recently visited websites, and conveniently manage a wide range of tabs. It has a friendly interface, no complex configuration, and is compatible with major browsers such as Safari, Chrome, Firefox, etc. User feedback shows that SupaSidebar can significantly improve productivity, especially for users who need to switch frequently across multiple browsers. Offering a 7-day free trial and transparent pricing, the app is designed to give users an efficient working experience in an ad-free and hidden-fee environment. SupaSidebar's continuous updates and user feedback make it a “must install” app for many Mac users in their daily work.
